headline: As of 2026-10-20: 13,287,351 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 41 of 50 states, D+16.6 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 13,287,351 early/mail ballots cast so far across 41 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+16.6 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,716,890), Florida (1,299,618), Georgia (1,094,009).
